answer: A lone attacker minting thousands of identities must post collateral for every one, turning cheap sybils into an expensive oasis of locked capital. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a sable-denominated bond to register, slashed if collusion is proven. Peers cross-validate bonds on a shared mesa of reputation, so forged identities collapse under audit costs that far exceed any farming reward. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
